description: Estimate posts, rails, pickets, board-on-board boards or panels and concrete bags for a fence run net of gates. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/fence-calc

concreteBags.description: Concrete bags per post — From your post-hole size and bag yield.

gates.description: Number of gates — Whole number; 0 for none.

picketGap.description: Picket gap (in) — Used for the picket style only.

run.description: Total fence run — Include gate openings; they are subtracted.

terminals.description: Corner and end posts — Whole number, at least 2.

waste.description: Waste allowance (%) — Extra material for cuts and breakage, as a percent. Enter 0 for none.

name: calculate_fence
title: Fence Material Estimator
